first.rationale: The concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the most direct current lever for restoring meaningful early use, a prerequisite for sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is highly consequential given the competitive threat but needs source verification for durability, margin, and customer-quality effects before displacing the product-health intervention. Verify the pricing and onboarding evidence because they are the two most decision-consequential archived claims for this week’s irreversible experiment slot.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified record shows higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), directly addressing both current completion and activation declines while supporting durable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly not sustainable. Monitor activation, meaningful-action completion, qualification, and retention by cohort; the current decline may have causes beyond flow friction.
